name: DCP — Delinquency observations by date and source system
description: Stored MIS observations grouped by observation date and source system: facilities observed, total arrears and loan balance summed, DPD averaged. One row is one observation date; nothing is interpolated between points, and the ARR book has a single observation (2026-06-30). Grain: SNAPSHOT (facility × observation date). Source: qdb_delinquencysnapshot. Narrowed by source system (text HL/BFD) and the observation-date window when supplied. DCP catalogue DCP-RPT-013.
fetchXml: <fetch aggregate="true"><entity name="qdb_delinquencysnapshot"><attribute name="qdb_snapshotdate" groupby="true" dategrouping="year" alias="year"/><attribute name="qdb_snapshotdate" groupby="true" dategrouping="month" alias="month"/><attribute name="qdb_snapshotdate" groupby="true" dategrouping="day" alias="day"/><attribute name="qdb_facilitysourcesystem" groupby="true" alias="source"/><attribute name="qdb_delinquencysnapshotid" aggregate="count" alias="facilities"/><attribute name="qdb_totalarrears" aggregate="sum" alias="arrears"/><attribute name="qdb_loanbalance" aggregate="sum" alias="balance"/><attribute name="qdb_dpd" aggregate="avg" alias="dpd"/><order alias="year"/><order alias="month"/><order alias="day"/></entity></fetch>
